title: Scale, Movement and Sense Capability Integration
objective: Connect scale profiles, locomotion modes and senses to shared capability/rules profiles so movement and senses are typed grants, derived values reference shared rules, and species do not create duplicate movement or sense engines.
acceptance: movement and senses are typed grants
derived values reference shared rules profiles
boundaries: MVPS-04 owns species-facing scale/movement/sense integration contracts only.
MVPS-03 morphology remains the structural body-plan source and is consumed by reference.
Shared scale, movement, action/effect and sense rules remain authoritative owners; MVPS-04 must reference them rather than duplicate formulas or engines.
Environmental tolerance belongs to MVPS-05; broader capability/natural-equipment grants belong to MVPS-06.
MVPS-05+ remain unauthorized until separately selected.
next_action: No MVPS-04 work remains. MVPS-05 is selected_not_started with no implementation branch or authority and requires a later owner Continue.

red.observed_failure: MVPS-04 regression failed because the integration, fixture and invariant artifacts did not exist.

reconciled_green.reason: UISR-09 closeout advanced AIOC main; only MVPS-04 implementation files were replayed.

roadmap_reconciliation.rationale: MVPS has no hard/start gate or milestone rotation overriding strict order after MVPS-04.
